name: Tomb of Duc Duc
kicker: Duc Duc’s worship hall, on its own ticket
summary: Walk the worship hall at Duc Duc's tomb, on its own ticket. An adult pays 50,000 VND, and a child from 7 to 12 enters free. The four-site ticket covers the Imperial City, Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh. Thủy Bằng in Hương Thủy, Duy Tân, and An Cựu all appear for this tomb. How long to stay, and the ride from the south bank, are Check on arrival.
getThere: Thủy Bằng in Hương Thủy, Duy Tân, and An Cựu. Ride: Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The worship hall across the court
gettingThere: Start from the south bank. Thủy Bằng in Hương Thủy, Duy Tân, and An Cựu all appear for this tomb. The ride is Check on arrival.

hours: 16 Mar–15 Oct: 06:30–18:00, tickets until 17:30. 16 Oct–15 Mar: 07:00–17:30, tickets until 17:00. Confirm the board on arrival.
admissionNote: Adult 50,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 enters free. Under 7 is free. Hue residents and the other half-price groups pay half. The four-site ticket is the Imperial City, Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh: 530,000 VND for an adult and 100,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12, for up to two days. The all-site ticket is 600,000 VND for an adult and 120,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12, for up to five days, and it includes this tomb.
